- **In-game chat and notes now span the whole draft match** (issue #463): a conversation/note started during game 1 of a best-of-three draft match is still there in game 2, and both are now usable during the drafting/deck-building phase itself, not just once a game is in progress.
- **New theming options** (issue #363): five color palettes (Jade, Red Marble, White Marble, High Contrast, High Contrast Dark) and four illustrated card-art skins (Noir, Steampunk, Futuristic, Neon) join System/Light/Dark in one unified theme picker, each with its own photographic/illustrated background; Steampunk also gets its own heading font.
- **Theme polish**: buttons and dropdown selects now pick up each theme's own colors instead of the browser default, and the themed backgrounds no longer visibly jump/snap while scrolling (including on mobile, when the browser's own address bar hides and shows).
- Fixed "Sealed Deck" showing as a raw "Draft, sealed_deck deck" label in the lobby, board title, and Open Games dialog.
- Fixed the loading screen overlay letting page content (icons, card art) show through behind it.
- Hostility can now target itself in its own second-stage discard, matching its printed text.
- Fixed Anger being unable to target a Superiority whose value would have dropped into budget once Anger itself entered play.
- The practice bot now targets an opponent's own mood, never its own, when playing Conviction.
- Fixed themed card art re-requesting a known-missing file on every board poll, which showed as a visible flicker.
